paper_verification.work: Revisiting Test-Case Prioritization on Long-Running Test Suites
paper_verification.status: ISSTA 2024 Technical Papers program page opened; research conference paper identity and DOI 10.1145/3650212.3680307 confirmed. Abstract supports 21,255 builds, 57,437 runs, 10 projects, 2020-23, 6.5h mean, 59 techniques, and faster/recently-failed heuristic result.
paper_verification.qualification: Supports a simple-start heuristic only in historical long-running CI prioritization with history; does not rank these eight causal investigations or establish local duration/history.

paper_verification.work: Effective Regression Test Case Selection: A Systematic Literature Review
paper_verification.status: Original report says DOI open failed 403 and relied on search abstract. Independent query did not surface a usable ACM record. Identity/47-study and 39% reproducibility claims not independently verified in this phase.
paper_verification.qualification: Secondary review; decision caution is plausible but the exact statistic remains unresolved.

paper_verification.work: Finding and Understanding Bugs in C Compilers (Yang et al., PLDI 2011)
paper_verification.status: Author-hosted paper surfaced in independent search; title/authors, PLDI 2011 provenance, three-year Csmith study, >325 reported bugs, differential comparison, and exclusion of undefined/unspecified behavior confirmed from indexed paper text.
paper_verification.qualification: Compiler differential-testing evidence is a distant analogy; provider comparison requires same specification, artifact/package and build identity. It does not support random campaign expansion here.

paper_verification.work: How Effectively Does Metamorphic Testing Alleviate the Oracle Problem?
paper_verification.status: Original report says IEEE access blocked and used search abstract. Independent search did not return a usable primary record; publication details and effect-size wording not checked.
paper_verification.qualification: Weak alternative; direct source contracts are already available for R01-R03/R09.

paper_verification.status: Search results identify the five authors, 2024 IEEE ICST research-paper track, title and abstract; IEEE open failed with an interstitial. Indexed abstract supports counts 136/115/127, 107 reliable reproductions and sleep-based timing perturbation.
paper_verification.qualification: Peer-reviewed conference-paper venue identity supported by conference program/IEEE metadata, but this verifier did not open full paper. Results apply to known TD flaky failures/dataset, not a diagnosis or prescribed sleep instrumentation for this project.

paper_verification.work: CHESS: A Systematic Testing Tool for Concurrent Software
paper_verification.status: Microsoft Research technical report MSR-TR-2007-149 (Nov. 2007), not a conference/journal record on this page. First-party abstract supports systematic interleaving of a given scenario and reproducible failures.
paper_verification.qualification: Supports controlled scheduling only where the relevant schedule is controllable/modelled; no exhaustive claim for native worker or browser transport here.

paper_verification.work: Combinatorial Methods for Event Sequence Testing
paper_verification.status: NIST record opened; author/date/title and ICST 2012 proceedings/workshop provenance confirmed. Abstract supports testing every t-event order.
paper_verification.qualification: Bounded sequence coverage requires a relevant event model; it does not establish the right model or project behavior.

paper_verification.work: Lifecycle of Flaky Tests; Empirical Study of Flaky Tests in Python; Empirical Study of Flaky Tests in JavaScript; Luo et al. flaky-tests analysis
paper_verification.locator: Originals list Microsoft Research page, arXiv pages, Cornell-hosted PDF.
paper_verification.status: Not independently reopened within cap. Preserve as author-reported source access; prevalence/generalization statements not rechecked here.
paper_verification.qualification: Existing report already treats these as population-specific; no prevalence ranking should select a cause.

paper_verification.work: Combinatorial Testing: Theory and Practice (NIST-hosted chapter)
paper_verification.status: Original report states opened full NIST-hosted chapter, but this verification used budget on other sources and did not independently reopen it; therefore source identity/access remains unverified by verifier.
paper_verification.qualification: Report's own summary properly limits subject-specific DOM 4-way results and says factors/valid combinations govern applicability. Citation status uncertain here.

paper_verification.work: GUI model pilot (Xie & Memon, ACM TOSEM 2008); Automated Test Oracles for GUIs (FSE 2000)
paper_verification.status: Original report says author/university abstract pages opened; verifier did not reopen within cap. Exact publication record and claims remain at abstract-only level and unverified here.
paper_verification.qualification: Event-context and intermediate-state oracle advice is plausible, but not repository-specific.

paper_verification.work: Simplifying and Isolating Failure-Inducing Input (Zeller & Hildebrandt, IEEE TSE 28(2), 2002)
paper_verification.status: University-hosted full paper opened; title/authors, Mozilla 95-action case reduced to 3 actions, and 1-minimal/limitations content are visible in paper. Journal article identity given in PDF; access full text confirmed.
paper_verification.qualification: Minimization follows stable reproduction and a defined oracle; it does not find a global minimum causal explanation.

paper_verification.work: The Oracle Problem in Software Testing: A Survey (Barr et al., IEEE TSE 2015)
paper_verification.status: Original report says author copy/full survey opened; verifier did not reopen within cap. Publication status/access not independently checked here.
paper_verification.qualification: Survey is not an oracle for this project; actual expected behavior must still be grounded in contracts/consumer expectations.

paper_verification.work: An Investigation of the Applicability of Design of Experiments to Software Testing (Kuhn & Reilly, 2002)
paper_verification.status: NIST first-party record opened; authors/date/27th NASA Goddard-IEEE SEW proceedings identity confirmed. Abstract supports >95% 4-way result for error reports from one browser and one server.
paper_verification.qualification: Preliminary, two-system, historical result; supports project-specific factor sampling only after factor/domain evidence, not blanket t-way sufficiency.

paper_verification.work: When tests collide: Evaluating and coping with the impact of test dependence (Lam, Zhang & Ernst, UW-CSE-15-03-01, 2015)
paper_verification.status: Author/university abstract opened; technical report provenance and 4 prioritization/6 selection/2 parallelization algorithms plus 111/665 XML-Security result on 16 CPUs confirmed.
paper_verification.qualification: Report/abstract, not peer-reviewed venue established on opened page. Supports checking dependence before treating order/parallelization as neutral; no evidence this suite is dependent.

paper_verification.work: Test them all, is it worth it? Assessing configuration sampling on the JHipster Web development stack (Halin et al.)
paper_verification.status: The verifier's open returned a generic publication-site shell, not the cited record. Original report says author publication page/abstract inspected but full text not opened. 26,000 configs, 80 machines, 4,376 CPU-hours, and 35.70% figure remain unverified here.
paper_verification.qualification: Retain as source-reported, population-specific evidence; it cannot determine this project's factor set, defect yield or budget.

deduplicated_decision_questions: Can the symptom be reproduced with source, consumer, configuration, input and observed state/result recorded?

Which exact boundary changes first under a matched discriminator: core/API state, adapter/shared GUI state, native producer/mailbox/UI consumer, browser lifecycle/client/transport/generated asset, editor transform/model, or flow producer/consumer?
Does the local registered fixture cover this exact configuration and consumer, and was it actually run? Registration/source is not execution.

Is there evidence of a multi-factor configuration or test dependence problem sufficient to justify combinatorial selection, ordering or parallelization research? If not, existing targeted checks dominate.
For differential comparison, are implementations/artifacts semantically equivalent and identified? Without provider/package/config identity, R03 comparison is confounded.

raw_qualified_unresolved_rejected.raw: Original eight hypothetical reports, excerpts, paper bibliographic/search records and reported study data remain source material, not observations of project behavior.
raw_qualified_unresolved_rejected.qualified: Source-grounded narrow predictions and study-specific research results only; apply only under the listed identity/configuration assumptions.
raw_qualified_unresolved_rejected.unresolved: All eight reports remain unreproduced; missing consumer/configuration identity listed per report; abstract-only or inaccessible citations are explicitly unverified by this phase.
raw_qualified_unresolved_rejected.rejected: No broad matrix/statistical test-ranking, generic 2-way/4-way sufficiency, short rerun-pass absence claim, arbitrary cross-provider differential conclusion, or registered-test-as-pass claim is justified by current evidence.

acceptance.eight_report_coverage: All R01-R08 have a source locator, fixture/registration limit and next discriminating question in source excerpts and submitted reports. R08 contains two separate symptom families, so preserve separate follow-ups.
acceptance.three_layer_consumer_coverage: Core/provider R01-R03; GUI/application/browser/editor R04-R08; build/retained-input/flow consumer evidence R09-R13 are represented, with exact downstream consumers still unknown where excerpts omit them.
acceptance.runtime_implication: None. No project test/run/build/configure or actual failure was observed.
acceptance.verification_status: Question answered within source excerpt and 16-operation literature cap; original publication/access/peer-review details for listed unresolved papers and broad registration inventory remain incomplete. Do not infer missing test registration universally from excerpt.
